record.question: In the reference $A1, which part is fixed?
record.explanation: In $A1, the dollar sign fixes column A; row 1 remains relative. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/switch-between-relative-absolute-and-mixed-references; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/calculate-multiple-results-by-using-a-data-table; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/set-or-clear-a-print-area-on-a-worksheet; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/add-or-change-the-background-color-of-cells-in-excel
